Frequency: Regenerated on every CI build and every release; re-scanned for vulnerabilities daily
Depth: All direct and transitive dependencies, including OS packages in the container image
Known Unknowns: Fields that cannot be determined are recorded as 'unknown' and listed in cert-in:known_unknowns
Distribution and Delivery: Public SBOM on the customer portal; private SBOM + VEX via signed API on request
Access Control: RBAC: read-only for customers, edit for product security, private SBOM restricted under NDA
Accommodation of Mistakes: Corrections issued as a new BOM version with incremented 'version' and same serialNumber
